title: 第七章 血光之灾不好意思我放肆一下
content_zh:
第七章【血光之灾？】
金条！
大拇指粗的那种。
不是一根，不是十根……
是一堆！
陈言眼睛都差点看直了！
老太太……这么有钱？
忽然之间，他想起自己年少的时候，老太太半开玩笑的说要给自己开蒙传艺，自己嫌弃的拒绝。
然后的这些年，自己为了买本民工漫画，都要省吃俭用。
跑去网吧包个夜，都舍不得喝一瓶营养快线。
我……
我这特么不是贱的么！
陈言忍不住抽了自己一个嘴巴！
早知今日……
网吧包夜？
我特么直接把包夜网吧老板娘啊！
不是……
我特么前二十年的穷，都是我自己硬找的？
脑子里那种震惊，各种吐槽，各种念头纷纷扰扰。
就这么如同敲锣打鼓了几分钟后，陈言才渐渐冷静下来。

冷下来一点后，智商重新回归，立刻意识到好像不妥。
这……一库的金条，值钱是值钱……但特么的没办法换成钱啊！
陈言压制心中的燥热，大概估算了一下这里的黄金。
每根金条的分量，上面的标记是100克。
乘以金条数。
再乘以现在的金价……
陈言倒吸一口兰州拉面。
脑子里大概估算出了价值：换算成龙国币，千万出头一点。
一千多万啊！
拿出三分之一，可以在金陵府买一套三居室的房子，外加一辆车。
剩下的存进银行买个保守的理财，一年也能有个一二十万的收益。
自己一个单身狗，有房有车，一年一二十万的收入。
可以躺平活的很滋润了。
不过……
陈言心中谨慎着：这么多黄金变现，也是麻烦事儿。
好在库里不光是黄金，还是有一些现钞的。
票子明显有些老旧些，绿油油的M国刀勒，和两大叠港钞。
刀勒是面值一百一张。
港钞都是一千一张的。
陈言清点了一下，大约十六万刀勒，和五万港钞。

这换算下来就百万出头的龙国币了。
百万，不少了，在苏省金陵府，可以买一套小公寓房的。
content_en:
Chapter Seven [Bloody Disaster? 】
Gold bars!
The kind that is as thick as your thumb.
Not one, not ten...
It’s a bunch!
Chen Yan's eyes almost went straight!
Old lady... so rich?
Suddenly, he remembered that when he was young, the old lady half-jokingly said that she wanted to teach him some skills, but he refused in disgust.
In the following years, I had to save money and save money in order to buy Migrant Comics.
Even if I go to an Internet cafe to spend the night, I can't bear to drink a bottle of Nutrition Express.
I...
Am I not a bitch!
Chen Yan couldn't help but slap himself in the mouth!
If I had known today...
Internet cafe night package?
I’m going to give the proprietress of the Internet cafe a night!
No...
My poverty for the first twenty years was all caused by me?
The shock, all kinds of complaints, and all kinds of thoughts in my mind.
After beating gongs and drums for a few minutes, Chen Yan gradually calmed down.
After cooling down a bit, my IQ returned again, and I immediately realized something was wrong.
This...a treasure trove of gold bars is worth money...but there's no way to convert it into money!
Chen Yan suppressed the heat in his heart and roughly estimated the gold here.
The weight of each gold bar is 100 grams.
Multiply by the number of gold bars.
Multiply that by the current price of gold…
Chen Yan took a sip of Lanzhou Ramen.
I roughly estimated the value in my mind: converted into Jackie Chan's national currency, it's a little over 10 million.
More than ten million!
With one third of it, you can buy a three-bedroom house in Jinling Mansion, plus a car.
The remaining money can be deposited in the bank to buy conservative financial management, and you can make an income of one or two hundred thousand a year.
I am single, have a house, a car, and an income of one or two hundred thousand a year.
I can lie down and feel very moist.
But...
Chen Yan was cautious: it would be troublesome to liquidate so much gold.
Fortunately, there is not only gold in the library, but also some cash.
The banknotes were obviously a bit older, with green M country knives and two large stacks of Hong Kong banknotes.
Daole has a face value of one hundred.
Hong Kong banknotes are issued in one thousand pieces.
Chen Yan counted it, and found about 160,000 knives and 50,000 Hong Kong dollars.
This translates into over a million Dragon Country coins.
One million is quite a lot. You can buy a small apartment in Jinling Prefecture, Jiangsu Province.
